reviews.review_title: Clothes are fabulous but.....
reviews.review_text: Clothes are fabulous! Shipping takes forever & customer service does not respond very quickly if you need something. I would order more often but things need to change with their shipping & customer service

reviews.review_title: We really liked the design and quality
reviews.review_text: We really liked the design and quality, which is why I purchased from you multiple times. However, the shipping took much longer than I expected. Thanks.

reviews.review_title: I wasn’t sure of my size and ordered…
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t sure of my size and ordered items that were too small.  I was able to get a “gift card” for Halara in a few clicks and ordered the right sizes.  Love the products.  Very comfortable, easy to launder, fits well.  I am pleased with the experience and will order again.

reviews.review_title: Love halara
reviews.review_text: I have loved nearly everything from halara.  The couple of items that didn’t work they readily allowed for an exchange.  Everything is super comfortable and price is great.

reviews.reply_text:
Hello,
We're sorry to hear about your experience and apologize for any confusion regarding your return and refund.
After reviewing your case, we can confirm that your refund was not issued as a gift card. Instead, our agent has already processed the refund back to your original payment method.

reviews.review_title: Your sizing is a tough one to square up…
reviews.review_text: Your sizing is a tough one to square up with. I measured myself and it indicates a large. I ordered a large and extra large just in case I wanted the shorts to be baggy. The extra large are not baggy and the large doesn’t fit. At all. They are a nice material and seem like quality clothes.
